**q25.** Engine: Google CEL (`github.com/google/cel-go`) wrapped by the in-repo filter package `internal/filter` (`engine.go:24` `NewEngine`/`Compile`/`CompileToStatement`, variable schema in `schema.go:232+`). Mechanism: the CEL expression is compiled to an AST, lowered into a dialect-neutral condition IR (`internal/filter/ir.go`, `parser.go`), then a `renderer` (`internal/filter/render.go:24`) emits dialect-specific SQL + bind args (`DialectSQLite`/`DialectPostgres`/`DialectMySQL` branches, e.g. render.go:231-238, 365-410), which each driver's `ListMemos` appends to its WHERE clause via `filter.AppendConditions` (`internal/filter/helpers.go:9`; call sites `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:61`, `store/db/postgres/memo.go:58`, `store/db/mysql/memo.go:69`).

Unused infra: `internal/scheduler` (a full cron-expression scheduler with parser/middleware, `internal/scheduler/scheduler.go`, `job.go`, `parser.go`) is imported only by its own tests (`internal/scheduler/example_test.go:10`, `integration_test.go:13`) — the server never uses it. Also `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:19` `NewRunner`/`RunOnce` is never called; only the standalone helper `RebuildMemoPayload` (:74) is used, from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`.

**q29.** Interceptor: `authInterceptor` in `web/src/connect.ts:148-172` (attached to the Connect transport at `:176`), backed by `web/src/auth-state.ts`. Tokens managed: a short-lived JWT **access token** (sent as `Authorization: Bearer`, stored in localStorage + shared across tabs via BroadcastChannel, preflight-refreshed near expiry and reactively refreshed once on `Unauthenticated`), and a **refresh token** held in an httpOnly cookie (`credentials: "include"`, `web/src/connect.ts:57-61`; `refreshToken` RPC at `:73`). Backend validation package: `server/auth` (`server/auth/authenticator.go` `Authenticate`/`resolveBearer`, `server/auth/token.go` — access token audience `user.access-token` 15 min, refresh token `user.refresh-token` 30 days in cookie `memos_refresh`, plus PATs prefixed `memos_pat_`), invoked through `Authorizer` (`server/router/api/v1/authz.go:34`) for both the gateway middleware and the Connect `AuthInterceptor` (`server/router/api/v1/connect_interceptors.go:213`).

The first three funnel through `APIV1Service.dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:47`); all four converge on `webhook.PostAsync` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`) → `webhook.Post` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`), which performs the signed HTTP POST.
